_docs.purpose: Schema-complete example for overrides.json. Copy to the path pointed at by OVERRIDES_JSON_PATH (default COLD_STORAGE_BASE_DIR/overrides.json) and edit values for your deployment. JSON has no comments, so per-section explanation lives in the _docs key of each section. Canonical field reference: docs/preserving_the_process/NON_SOVEREIGN_TERRITORIES_AND_OVERRIDES.md sections 2.1-2.3. Validate with: python manage.py verify_paths --strict.
_docs.loader: backend/core/services/snapshot/country_override_service.py:load_overrides() also accepts a flat legacy mapping like {"IE": "ireland"} at the top level, but the structured schema below is preferred.
_docs.settings: backend/backend/settings.py:155 OVERRIDES_JSON_PATH env var, default COLD_STORAGE_BASE_DIR/overrides.json.
_docs.boot_validation: python manage.py verify_paths loads this file and checks every embedding_splits poly against POLYGON_FILES_DIR/overrides/ then root (same order as EmbeddingSpatialSplitService.resolve_poly_path). Missing polys are errors under --strict. Polys live in cold storage, not the repo, so a bare checkout will report them as missing; that is correct behavior.

_docs.purpose: Maps official ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes to pipeline-specific slugs for Geofabrik/embedding alignment. Used by get_country_slug() when the OSM-derived slug does not match the Geofabrik dataset directory name.

fields.embedding_slug: GeoVectors dataset directory name (optional, used when the embedding folder name differs from the country slug)
fields.slug: Legacy alias for country_slug (country_slug takes precedence)

_docs.purpose: Documents shared embedding shards across countries (memory optimization). A country can borrow another dataset's location index or tag embeddings instead of materializing its own. Optional section; most deployments leave it empty.

fields.shared_location_overrides: Array of {override_type, source, targets, note?} targets reuse the source's location embeddings.
fields.shared_tag_overrides: Array of {override_type, source, targets} targets reuse the source's tag embeddings.

_docs.purpose: Spatial splits (one TSV -> many) and merges (many TSVs -> one) for embeddings that ship as a combined shard but need per-country or per-territory outputs. Required by preprocess_embeddings and scan_embeddings.

split_fields.source_tsv: Path relative to EMBEDDINGS_ROOT of the input TSV (gz)
split_fields.continent: Continent slug for the PBF snapshot
split_fields.targets.slug: Lowercase ISO code or territory slug (e.g. scotland, im, gg)
split_fields.targets.poly: Polygon file relative to POLYGON_FILES_DIR; resolved against POLYGON_FILES_DIR/overrides/ then root by EmbeddingSpatialSplitService.resolve_poly_path

merge_fields.shards: Array of input TSV paths relative to EMBEDDINGS_ROOT

_docs.config_loader: backend/core/services/snapshot/embedding_spatial_split_service.py:load_embedding_splits_config() reads {splits, merges}; malformed sections degrade to empty, not errors.
_docs.dataclass: SplitTargetConfig at embedding_spatial_split_service.py:26-31 fields slug, poly, output.
_docs.poly_bug_note: A combined shard (e.g. malaysia-singapore-brunei) must point every target at the SAME combined .poly file. Pointing each target at a per-country .poly that does not exist on disk will fail verify_paths --strict and raise FileNotFoundError mid-pipeline.

_docs.purpose: Optional per-continent overrides keyed by embedding/folder name. Currently has no worked example in the schema doc and no in-repo callers exercise specific fields; kept here as a placeholder so operators know the section exists. Populate with whatever fields get_continent_override() consumers in your deployment read.
